com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Mark the selected invoices as distinct and retain each invoice. Changes duplicate grouping only; saved validation warnings and accounting holds remain. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview marking the invoices we selected from this group as distinct. Show the exact invoices and explain that saved validation warnings remain, then wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_dismiss_duplicate_group, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare marking the selected invoices as distinct rather than duplicates. Requires confirmation; invoices are retained.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: dismiss_duplicate_group
title: Mark invoices as distinct
